conflicts.permit: We do not collect any payment information from the Users except for details relating to bank accounts and payment wallets.
conflicts.prohibit: Users, whenever require to make any payment to us, will simply directed to go to a retailer’s website to make a transaction and hence the privacy policies for such retailers shall be applicable.
conflicts.situation: When a user makes a payment to the platform via bank account or payment wallet.
conflicts.reason: The policy first states that it collects bank account and payment wallet details, but then immediately asserts all user payments are made on external retailer websites under retailer policies.
